import { html } from 'common-tags'

export const registryItem = {
  type: 'registry:ui',
  name: 'datetime-picker',
  title: 'DatetimePicker',

  description: html`
    A datetime picker component that combines a calendar with
    a scrollable time picker for selecting both date and time.

    References:
    - shadcn/ui: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/date-picker
  `,

  dependencies: [
    '@ark-ui/vue',
    '@internationalized/date',
    '@vueuse/core',
  ],

  registryDependencies: [
    'button',
    'calendar',
    'popover',
    'scroll-area',
    'separator',
  ],
}

export default registryItem

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CalendarDateTime } from '@internationalized/date'

import { ref } from 'vue'

import { DatetimePicker } from '@/components/ui/datetime-picker'

const datetime = ref<CalendarDateTime>()
</script>

<template>
  <DatetimePicker.Root v-model="datetime" :hour-cycle="24">
    <DatetimePicker.Trigger />
    <DatetimePicker.Content />
  </DatetimePicker.Root>
</template>
